R5 top-layer attended matrix

This fixture creates page conditions only. It never creates a scrollbar host or substitute rail. Only actual browser rendering and user interaction can qualify visibility. Reload each selected scene with the temporary extension loaded. Native scrollbars must remain underneath.

For every visible case: drag the thumb, click the track and wheel over that narrow strip. Wheel outside the strip stays page-owned. Hidden/clip/inert/fully-clipped cases must have no rail. Open page modal/popover UI must hide every Browser UX rail; closing must recover after normal reevaluation.
